Full Resort & Room Tour: Disney's Caribbean Beach Resort | Walt Disney World
Take a complete tour of Disney's Caribbean Beach Resort at Walt Disney World Resort! From the colorful island-inspired villages and relaxing white-sand beaches to the spacious guest rooms, Fuentes del Morro Pool, and convenient access to the Disney Skyliner, we're exploring everything this tropical Disney Resort hotel has to offer.
 
Along the way, we'll share resort amenities, recreation offerings, dining locations, transportation options, and helpful tips to make the most of your stay at Disney's Caribbean Beach Resort.
